description: This file contains unit tests for the ApiVersionUtil class, focusing on parsing, serializing, sanitizing, and retrieving preferred API versions, using JUnit and Robolectric for testing in an Android environment.

classes.name: ApiVersionUtilTest
classes.description: Test class for ApiVersionUtil methods, verifying parsing, serialization, sanitization, and version preference logic.

methods.name: testParse_invalid_one
methods.description: Tests parsing invalid inputs such as null, empty, whitespace, malformed JSON arrays, ensuring the result is an empty collection.

methods.name: testParse_valid_one
methods.description: Tests parsing valid single API version representations in different formats, verifying correct extraction of major and minor versions.

methods.name: testParse_invalid_many
methods.description: Tests parsing of malformed arrays with invalid elements, ensuring only valid API versions are returned.

methods.name: testParse_valid_many
methods.description: Tests parsing of arrays with multiple valid API versions in various formats, verifying correct collection contents.

methods.name: testSerialize
methods.description: Tests serialization of API version collections, including nulls and duplicates, ensuring JSON string correctness.

methods.name: testSanitize
methods.description: Tests the sanitization method, which cleans up malformed or null-containing lists to produce a valid JSON array string.

methods.name: testGetPreferredApiVersion
methods.description: Tests retrieving the preferred API version from various JSON string inputs, including invalid and ordered lists, verifying correct selection.
